sources.title: ThunderAI (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Ollama) :: Add-ons for Thunderbird
sources.snippet: ThunderAI uses the capabilities of ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude or Ollama to enhance email management. It enables users to analyze, write, correct, assign tags, create calendar events and tasks and optimize their emails.
